title: 3D Fox A* Pathfinding
physics_constraints: 15 random obstacles, start (0,0) and end (9,9) clear
A* with Manhattan distance heuristic, 4-directional movement
difficulty_analysis: L4: Loading an animated Fox model with GLTFLoader, managing transitions between multiple animations with AnimationMixer, implementing the A* pathfinding algorithm, generating grid terrain and obstacles, detecting cell clicks with Raycaster, visualizing the path, and moving and automatically rotating the fox cell by cell along the path.
